Automation: Rules reference · resolve effects at the table

You judge the bottle's color and work down the line, giving each companion the mouthful their shaking hands cannot manage.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
Knowledge
Time
Maneuver to administer; one hour per crafting attempt.
Target / range / shape
Self or up to two adjacent willing or unconscious creatures.
Equipment / acquisition
A free hand; mixing kit (Bulk 1), supplied on learning if needed; prepared tonic when administering.
Type
Skill / Crafting / Recovery

Use the tonic: Use a prepared Clearing Tonic supply for each recipient and make one Knowledge roll. Choose temporary Poisoned or Dazed for each.

Weak
Reduce Poisoned by 2 or Dazed by 1.
Standard
Reduce Poisoned by 3 or Dazed by 2.
Strong
Reduce Poisoned by 4 or Dazed by 3.

Check the supply after each use.

Brew: Learn Clearing Tonic and Travel Food. With the Clearing Tonic recipe's tools and materials, make or refill one tonic supply to d4 in one hour, without a roll. Craft Travel Food with its full interval and materials, making a Knowledge roll for 1/2/3 inventory steps on Weak/Standard/Strong, up to d8.

Source: design/cards/the-cleverest-mixture.md at f3fb98ca03b046335fcc730c1b05689bebf091b4.
